name: Raven's Home
description: Best friends Raven and Chelsea, now both divorced mothers, are raising their children in a house together. Their house is turned upside down when they realize one of Raven's children inherited the same psychic abilities as their mother.

videos.title: Far From Raven's Home
videos.overview: Raven and Chelsea take the kids on a trip to an island named Notsuoh, inviting Tess too. Everyone has their own expectations from the vacation, but Booker is hoping for an adventure like his hero, Artifact Jack. In the jungle with a tour guide named Danny, Booker has a vision of Danny and a mummy holding him up in celebration as Danny says "You saved us!"

videos.title: Baxter's Back
videos.overview: Booker enlists Levi and Tess to help him convince Nia of his newfound abilities to see into the future. Meanwhile, Raven’s latest vision involves a family disagreement that leads her to meddle in her kids’ life at school.

videos.title: Big Trouble in Little Apartment
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to Raven, Nia is starting to feel like their apartment isn’t big enough for everyone and turns to her dad Devon for help.

videos.title: The Baxters Get Bounced
videos.overview: When the landlord Mr. Jablonski raises Raven’s rent after learning Chelsea and Levi have moved in, Nia and Booker try to hold a yard sale to help their mom.

videos.title: The Bearer of Dad News
videos.overview: When Raven has a vision of Booker and Nia being upset over their dad’s move, she goes overboard trying to do all of the fun activities Devon normally did with the kids.

videos.title: You're Gonna Get It
videos.overview: When Nia sneaks to school wearing makeup against Raven’s wishes, she draws the attention of the 8th grade girls who invite her to hang out.

videos.title: Adventures in Mommy-Sitting
videos.overview: Booker, Nia, and Levi convince Raven and Chelsea they are responsible enough to watch themselves while the moms celebrate a “moms’ night out.”

videos.title: Dancing Tween
videos.overview: While Booker and Tess team up to plan their 6th grade dance, Nia worries her dancing skills aren’t good enough for the big event. Meanwhile, Raven starts to question if she’s being a good mom and goes overboard trying to volunteer for the kids’ school.

videos.title: Vending the Rules
videos.overview: When Booker and Levi want expensive virtual reality goggles, the boys come up with a plan to make money by selling snacks at school.

videos.title: In-Vision of Privacy
videos.overview: When Booker has a vision of Tess getting her heart broken, he and Levi try to prevent it from happening.

videos.title: Fears of a Clown
videos.overview: A cool new kid arrives in the building, causing Booker and Levi to fight Nia and Tess for his attention.

videos.title: The Baxtercism of Levi Grayson
videos.overview: Booker and Levi try to prank a classmate into thinking their apartment building is haunted. Meanwhile, Nia gets chickenpox and Tess comes up with a plan to make sure her BFF doesn't miss out on Halloween.

videos.title: Dream Moms
videos.overview: When Booker and Levi get into some trouble backstage at a concert, Raven and Chelsea try to seize the moment to perform with their all-time favorite group La Dee Da.

videos.title: Vest in Show
videos.overview: When Booker has a vision of Raven getting fired from her job during Doggy Fashion Week, he tries to help his mom with her designs.

videos.title: The Falcon and The Raven - Part One
videos.overview: When Booker has a vision of his mom losing the money hidden in her backpack, he enlists Nia and Levi to help him follow Raven and rescue the money before it goes missing.

videos.title: The Falcon and The Raven – Part Two
videos.overview: Raven finally admits to the kids that she has visions too and shares a special moment with Booker and they try to combine their psychic powers to find the missing money. Feeling left out, Nia pretends to have a vision.

videos.title: Because
videos.overview: When Booker wants to reveal his powers to increase his popularity at school, Raven warns him to keep his psychic powers a secret.

videos.title: Cop to It
videos.overview: When the new building manager accuses someone of tagging the side of their building, Raven thinks Tess is responsible.

videos.title: Weirder Things
videos.overview: The kids win a contest to attend a private screening of their favorite TV show, but their plans are interrupted when Raven makes them babysit Dreamweaver Kema’s precocious niece.

videos.title: Missteps
videos.overview: Nia and Tess form a step dance squad to take down the school’s reigning champs, but their friendship is tested when they can’t agree on how the team should be run.

videos.title: All Sewn Up
videos.overview: When Nia gets caught up in wanting to be a trendsetter, she goes against her mother’s wishes and uses the money she saved up to buy an expensive jacket. Meanwhile, Booker has a vision that Mitch put a curse on him.

videos.title: Oh Father, Where Art Thou?
videos.overview: Nia is excited her dad is flying in for her school’s Father/Daughter dance, but when Raven has a vision, Devon is stuck in a snowstorm and may not make it – she does everything she can to make sure Nia isn’t disappointed.

videos.title: The Trouble with Levi
videos.overview: When Levi is moved up to Booker’s science class, he inadvertently cramps Booker’s style with his classmates.

videos.title: Head Over Wheels
videos.overview: When Levi’s new crush Isabella tries to visit but can’t come upstairs because of her wheelchair, Nia and Tess try to convince Mitch to make the building wheelchair-accessible. Meanwhile, Booker tries to help Levi win Isabella’s attention over another boy.

videos.title: The Most Interesting Mom in the World
videos.overview: While doing a school report on their mother, Booker and Nia lie about Raven's life to make their presentation seem more exciting.

videos.title: Sleevemore Part One: Frozen
videos.overview: When Booker freezes mid-vision, Raven takes him to Dr. Sleevemore – the same doctor who helped her when she was a teen.

videos.title: Sleevemore Part Two: Found
videos.overview: When Booker loses his powers to see glimpses of the future, he gains new abilities as an incredible chef and magician. Meanwhile, Nia discovers she has Booker’s powers to see visions.

videos.title: Sleevemore Part Three: Future
videos.overview: When Dr. Slevemore tries to try to transfer Booker’s visions back, they learn Jasmine took the visions away from Nia the night before.

videos.title: Raven's Home: Remix
videos.overview: Booker sets out to land the starring role in the school’s musical about a boy who loves playing basketball and performing hip-hop. Nia tries to convince Coach Spitz to let Tess audition for the role. When he refuses because Tess is a girl, a determined Nia takes a stand to prove girls can do anything boys can do.

videos.title: Switch-or-Treat
videos.overview: Booker and Raven’s psychic powers cause them to switch bodies on Halloween. When their Aunt Maureen comes to warn them, she inadvertently switches bodies with Nia’s crush Miles.

videos.title: Just Call Me Vic
videos.overview: Encouraged by her twins, Raven finally begins seriously pursuing the possibility of achieving the job of her dreams by seeking out an assistant--preferably an unpaid one. Meanwhile, her father, Victor comes to visit.

videos.title: New Dog, Old Trick
videos.overview: When Raven accompanies Nia on her retreat for the Young Leaders of Tomorrow, she becomes more focused on talking to Shinee Dubois about her new fashion line.

videos.title: It's Your Party and I'll Spy If I Want To
videos.overview: When Nia and Booker throw an epic 13 birthday party with no moms or kids allowed, they’re forced to tell Raven and Levi they can’t attend.

videos.title: Winners and Losers
videos.overview: Booker and Nia are excited when they’re named student Ambassadors of their school, that is until they learn that their first job is to welcome Mitch as a new student.

videos.title: Keepin’ It Real
videos.overview: Raven secures social influencer Lil Z to appear at the launch of her fashion show, but the kids compromise everything when they use Lil Z’s name to sell raffle tickets without his permission.

videos.title: Friend-Ship
videos.overview: Raven and the kids plan a road trip to visit Chelsea at her cruise ship and encounter several obstacles along the way.

videos.title: Lost at Chel-Sea
videos.overview: The kids accidentally get stuck on a cruise ship alone, while Raven and Chelsea desperately try to catch up with them via Jet Ski.

videos.title: Smoky Flow
videos.overview: Booker, Tess and Nia form a music group, The Chi-Lective, with Levi as their video director. Things get out of hand when they try and film their music video “Smokey Flow” in Tess’ apartment—unbeknownst to Raven and Chelsea.

videos.title: Twister, Sister
videos.overview: When Booker challenges Nia’s efforts as an activist, she follows her dad to where he’s reporting on a storm to prove to herself and her brother that she is indeed an activist and not a “positivist.”

videos.title: Dress to Express
videos.overview: When Levi makes a documentary to see how a person’s style influences people’s perception of them, he has Nia, Tess and Booker change up their style of dress which leads to surprising results.

videos.title: Diss Track
videos.overview: Nia, Tess and Booker are ecstatic over the popularity of their Chi-Lective music video that has gotten thousands of likes on MeTube, until Levi shows them a diss track that’s been posted by a rival group, The 3 Go’s, that makes fun of Booker.

videos.title: Disorder in the Court
videos.overview: Levi’s dad, Garrett, returns from prison, but Raven, Chelsea and the kids are dismayed to discover that he has stolen Chelsea’s invention “The Schmop.”

videos.title: School House Trap
videos.overview: The kids make it to the next round in the Radio Eclipse music competition, but Raven threatens to take away their band when Booker gets a bad grade.

videos.title: Cali Dreams
videos.overview: The kids head to L.A. with the whole family to compete in the finals of a music competition hosted by radio personality and former boy band star, Chris Springlakes.

videos.title: Creepin' It Real
videos.overview: When a new neighbor moves in next door on Halloween, the kids collect enough evidence that suggests he could be an evil being.

videos.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Phones
videos.overview: Tess and Nia square off with Chelsea and Raven to see who can go without technology the longest.

videos.title: Friday Night Tights
videos.overview: Booker joins ballet club to win over Danni, but quits when the coolest kid in school makes fun of it.

videos.title: It's Not Easy Being Green
videos.overview: Booker gets jealous when Danni strikes up a friendship with Nia and Tess. Levi helps Raven and Chelsea realize they should combine their businesses.

videos.title: Crewed Up
videos.overview: Levi starts hanging with a “nerdy” posse, making Booker jealous.

videos.title: Sorry to Father You
videos.overview: Chelsea and Raven’s relaxing spa weekend goes awry after leaving their kids with Devon.

videos.title: Bah Humbugged
videos.overview: When Booker has a vision that his mom and dad are getting back together over the Holidays, he tries to recreate every family tradition from Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanza to help set the mood. Meanwhile, Raven and Garrett butt heads in the kitchen.

videos.title: The Foreign Identity
videos.overview: When Nia gets a crush on the new French exchange student, Timothée, she pretends to be a sophisticated Brit to win him over and enlists Booker to help her keep up the ruse.

videos.title: What About Your Friends?
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to her kids, Raven still catches glimpses of the future, and unbeknownst to her, Booker has just learned he has these same abilities. Hilarity ensues as Raven and Booker’s visions collide, but no matter the situation, they figure everything out together as one big happy family.

videos.title: Adolessons
videos.overview: Booker and Nia endure growing pains; Chelsea has a "magical" encounter.

videos.title: Close Shave
videos.overview: When Booker shirks his responsibilities, helping Mr. Arthur at the local barbershop to attend a concert promoted by Chris Spring-Lake, Mr. Arthur recruits Raven to do her son’s work.

videos.title: Hoop Streams
videos.overview: When the school’s basketball team makes it to the National Championship, Tess rallies everyone to help her host a live telethon to raise funds for the team to travel.

videos.title: Slammed
videos.overview: When Booker becomes responsible for choosing who will represent the class at the district poetry slam, Nia thinks she has a guaranteed spot on the team. Meanwhile, Raven and Chelsea start a DIY renovation on their new business space.

videos.title: On Edge
videos.overview: When Mr. Arthur tells Booker that he isn't ready to go from sweeping floors to cutting hair at the barbershop, Booker opens his own mobile barbershop in the boys' school bathroom.

videos.title: The Story So-Fa
videos.overview: When Nia and Levi surprise their moms with a new couch and donate the old one, Raven and Chelsea reveal that they stored Chelsea's settlement money in the cushions!

videos.title: In-Shoe-encer
videos.overview: Nia becomes an influencer after winning a contest sponsored by a shoe company … until Levi breaks the news that the shoe company doesn’t stand for the things Nia believes.

videos.title: Level Up
videos.overview: Raven and Chelsea anticipate an appearance on Chris Spring-Lake's TV show, will spotlight their new joint business venture. Unfortunately, the self-absorbed host only seems capable of promoting himself.

videos.title: Raven About Bunk’d
videos.overview: Raven, Chelsea, Booker, Nia, Levi, and Tess set out on a long road trip to Maine’s Camp Champion, but a GPS glitch sends them off course to Camp Kikiwaka, a place with an uncertain future even for those who can catch a glimpse of the future.

videos.title: Don't Trust the G in Apartment 4B
videos.overview: Now that they are high school students, Booker and Nia feel they are too old for trick-or-treating. They instead convince Levi, Tess and Ramon to join them for a night of real scares and fun in 4B, the apartment that is suspected to be haunted.

videos.title: Baking Bad
videos.overview: When Raven and Nia each become embroiled in cases of mistaken identity, they must deal with the ensuing ramifications. While Raven tries to rectify a client's impulsive actions, Nia finds herself forced into an exhibition of her (nonexistent) baking skills.

videos.title: Big Little Surprise
videos.overview: Nia, Booker, Levi and Chelsea secretly plan a big surprise party for Raven’s birthday. Unbeknownst to her family, Raven accepted a job driving singing-sensation Sunrise Mahoney around and is sworn to secrecy.

videos.title: Tesscue Me
videos.overview: Booker and Nia devise a plan to attend their first high school party with Tess without Raven’s knowledge. Back at the party, Tess accepts a dance battle challenge against Mikka, and things get out of hand.

videos.title: Sharp Job-jects
videos.overview: When Booker and Nia realize they have no money for all of their fun summer plans, they try to get assistant jobs with Raven’s persnickety client, Priya.

videos.title: How I Met Your Mentor
videos.overview: Nia is matched with a high school mentor, whose personality, values and sense of style couldn’t be more different.

videos.title: Mad About Yuletide
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve and the Baxter/Grayson family are trying to make the best of the holiday when a storm hits and disrupts their plans to celebrate together at a cabin on the lake.

videos.title: Wheel of Misfortune
videos.overview: It’s the first week of high school, and Nia, Booker and Tess find themselves growing in different ways. Nia tries to join all the school clubs her bestie, Tess, is joining but ends up feeling like a third wheel to Tess and Ramon’s blossoming relationship.

videos.title: Diff'rent Strikes
videos.overview: When school is interrupted by a Chicago teachers’ strike, Booker has a vision and enlists Nia, Levi and Tess to help him start a home study group that quickly spirals out of control.

videos.title: Fresh Off the Note
videos.overview: When Booker suspects that Nia's friend Olivia has a crush on him, he decides to put a "let's be friends" note in her locker but accidentally puts it in Tess' locker.

videos.title: 10 Things Debate About You
videos.overview: After Levi helps convince Booker to join the debate team, he and Booker are pitted against each other in order to prepare for the big tournament.

videos.title: Plays of Our Lives
videos.overview: When Booker has a vision of Levi being ousted from his first big stage role, he goes against Levi's wishes and asks Chelsea for advice.

videos.title: The Slumber Years
videos.overview: Raven reminds the kids to take a break from their screens as they settle into their nightly routines, but Booker, Nia and Levi have other plans.

videos.title: Bless This Tess
videos.overview: When Raven tells the kids that Tess can't keep coming and going during quarantine, Booker, Nia and Levi suggest Tess temporarily move in.

videos.title: American Torah Story
videos.overview: With his bar mitzvah approaching, Levi realizes he didn't take full advantage of being a kid. Booker encourages Levi to enjoy his childhood to the fullest before becoming a man.

videos.title: Say Yes to the Protest
videos.overview: Nia wants to take part in a protest to protect the environment, but first, she has to convince her mom to let her attend. Meanwhile, Raven volunteers to help Levi with his S.T.E.M. project but inadvertently takes over.

videos.title: Saved by the Belle
videos.overview: Booker sets out to win "Freshest Freshman" for the yearbook, but he's outdone by Nia when she performs the Heimlich maneuver and saves him from choking. Now, Nia is enjoying her new status as a school hero.

videos.title: So You Think You Can Drive
videos.overview: Booker and Nia have their learner's permits, but Raven isn't ready to teach them how to drive! When their dad comes to Chicago to help with driving lessons, Nia starts to wonder if she's even ready to drive. Meanwhile, Chelsea reluctantly prepares Levi for his first trip alone to visit his dad in London.

videos.title: The Wrong Victor
videos.overview: When Raven’s father, Victor, has a health scare, Raven and Booker return to San Francisco to help. Booker fails to babysit his cousin and must fix things before Raven finds out.

videos.title: The Big Sammich
videos.overview: Raven wants to help Victor maintain a healthy lifestyle and leads by example. Meanwhile, Booker finds a way to impress his Grandpa, but it may just undo all of Raven’s hard work.

videos.title: Escape Pal-Catraz
videos.overview: A trip to Alcatraz gets Booker, Ivy and Neil into trouble. After a vision of unsafe practices at the Chill Grill, Raven decides to run the restaurant to prevent a catastrophe.

videos.title: A Streetcar Named Conspire
videos.overview: Booker's visit to San Francisco is ending, but Raven wants him to stay so pulls out all the stops to get him to stay. Booker is more interested in a girl than spending time with Raven. Meanwhile, Victor builds Alice the doll house of her dreams.

videos.title: Clique Bait
videos.overview: Booker tries to impress a girl, but it takes a turn for the worse. After a vision, Raven tries to prove to Victor that Alice is lying to him about losing her voice, but he doesn't believe her.

videos.title: 21 Lunch Street
videos.overview: When valuable items go missing, Booker, Ivy and Neil play detective to catch the culprit. In the meantime, wanting to be cool leaves Victor hanging on for dear life.

videos.title: Retreat Yourself
videos.overview: After having a vision about his health, Raven takes Victor to a relaxation retreat. Meanwhile, Booker learns that it's Alice's birthday and throws an impromptu party for her.

videos.title: New Kid on the Chopping Block
videos.overview: A new kid at school is stealing Booker's shine, so Booker attempts to one-up him. Meanwhile, Raven's mission aims to bring back the arts program at her old high school, Bayside High.

videos.title: Mr. Petracelli's Revenge
videos.overview: In order to inherit Victor’s classic car, Booker must get straight A’s. But Raven’s former teacher, Mr. Petracelli, swears there’s no way Booker will earn an A in his class.

videos.title: Date Expectations
videos.overview: Desperate to take Cami to a dance, Booker convinces Ivy to throw a party at the Chill Grill. But Cami’s plans get in the way of Ivy having a successful party.

videos.title: The Great Chill Grill Giveaway
videos.overview: Ivy forms a Trivia team with friends, but the team makes a decision that causes Booker to jeopardize Trivia Night; Raven puts the Chill Grill at risk.

videos.title: Truth or Hair
videos.overview: Raven takes Alice to the hair salon and hears a rumor about Victor. Trying to eavesdrop, Raven causes a disaster.

videos.title: Munch Ado About Lunching
videos.overview: Raven doesn't like that Booker and Cami's relationship is getting serious. Victor thinks about taking back over the Chill Grill, but he questions if he's still a good chef.

videos.title: To Halve & Halve Not
videos.overview: Raven changes the Chill Grill, causing tension between her and Victor. Booker feels torn between the two of them. Meanwhile, Ivy and Neil become confused about their friendship.

videos.title: The Fierce Awakens
videos.overview: Raven wants an influencer to promote her new design studio. So, Neil and Alice train Ivy to model in the way of “The Fierce.”

videos.title: The Grand Booker-Pest Hotel
videos.overview: Booker and Neil turn the Baxter house into a Hotel to make money to fix Booker’s car. Raven hosts a pop-up and pretends to be someone else to help Ivy impress female entrepreneurs.

videos.title: The Girl Who Cried Tasha
videos.overview: Alice uses a spell to bring her doll, Tasha, to life. But when Tasha refuses to return to being a doll, Alice must enlist the help of Booker, Ivy and Neil.

videos.title: Tying the Astro-Knot
videos.overview: Booker has a vision that Ivy is hindering her mom's campaign. Meanwhile, Raven gets to design a wedding gown for a prominent client and goes to extremes to make it happen.

videos.title: Keeping It 100
videos.overview: Neil and Ivy ask Booker to keep them out of his visions, but he has a vision that they're in a bind and doesn't know what to do. Victor and Alice celebrate Bayside High's 100th year.

videos.title: Stylin' & Profilin
videos.overview: Booker gets Raven's permission to drive his car to a school event, and things go well until he has an eye-opening encounter with a cop. Meanwhile, Victor breaks Alice's doll and scrambles to make amends.

videos.title: Big Burger, Small Fry
videos.overview: Booker's previous encounter with a cop causes him to act like a child. Meanwhile, Neil drags Ivy on an adventure to catch the burger that got away.

videos.title: Raven and the Fashion Factory
videos.overview: When Raven discovers Donna Cabonna's plans to steal fashion designs, she forms her own plan to outsmart her. Meanwhile, Booker meets a girl who makes him question things with Cami.

videos.title: A Day Without Baxters
videos.overview: When the family refuses to take part in Alice and Ivy's safety plan, they try to trick them but instead end up accidentally locking themselves and the family in the basement.

videos.title: Bridge Over Troubled Daughte
videos.overview: When Raven has a vision that could change her family forever, she is determined to stop it from happening. Meanwhile, Booker attempts to buy the best gift for Victor's birthday.

videos.title: A Country Cousin Christmas
videos.overview: Alice's family arrive for a surprise holiday reunion. Meanwhile, Booker attempts to harness his powers to acquire the perfect Christmas present for himself.

videos.title: European Rae-cation (1)
videos.overview: When the Baxters go to London to visit Victor, Alice gets mistaken as royalty. Neil and Lazlo's Chill Grill advertisement brings in a crowd they weren't expecting.

videos.title: European Rae-cation (2)
videos.overview: Alice runs into trouble at Buckingham Palace and Raven, Booker and Victor come to the rescue. Meanwhile, Neil and Lazlo try to get the unexpected patrons out of the Chill Grill.

videos.title: Sold to the Highest Fibber
videos.overview: When Raven claims that she can't be pranked, Victor tries to pull an epic prank on her. Meanwhile, Booker helps Alice with a design disaster.

videos.title: Blues Beard's Revenge
videos.overview: When the Baxters go to London to visit Victor, Alice gets mistaken as royalty. Neil and Lazlo's Chill Grill advertisement brings in a crowd they weren't expecting.

videos.title: Tess Friends Forever
videos.overview: When the Baxters go to London to visit Victor, Alice gets mistaken as royalty. Neil and Lazlo's Chill Grill advertisement brings in a crowd they weren't expecting.

videos.title: A.I., A.I., Oh...Snap!
videos.overview: Alice turns the Baxter home into a smart house to one-up her school rival Dylan. Raven gets to be on a famous reality TV show.

videos.title: Lizard Let Lie
videos.overview: On the eve of Raven's big reality show debut, Alice lies to get out of a class speech, and Victor tries to get out of a surprise health inspection.

videos.title: Ain't That a Sidekick in the Head
videos.overview: Booker volunteers with Neil at the hospital where they dress up as superheroes to entertain kids. Ivy tries to find out what sport she's best suited for.

videos.title: What Had Happened Was…
videos.overview: A school test question about the end of slavery puts Alice in a moral dilemma. Booker and Cami recap their breakup.

videos.title: Sneaks and Geeks
videos.overview: Booker, Neil and Ivy sneak out to go to an escape room Raven has also snuck out to. Alice helps Victor after he accidentally drinks one of her experiments.

videos.title: Reality Check
videos.overview: During the first day of shooting of Raven's reality show, Raven and Booker accidentally reveal secrets on camera. The reality show producers think Victor is boring.

videos.title: Working for the Weekend
videos.overview: Booker, Neil and Ivy do everything they can to get tickets to The Weeknd concert. Alice's classmate uninvites her to the same concert. Raven tries to cheer her up.

videos.title: Drop It Like It's Hot!
videos.overview: Raven is doing a clothing drop, but a miscommunication sends her fans to the Baxter house. Neil and Booker get into a disagreement. Alice has to help Pop-Pop at the Chill Grill.

videos.title: Raven's Clone
videos.overview: In preparation for the SMET Gala, Raven recruits a super fan to assist her. While on a field trip to the museum, Alice, Dylan and her new friend, Bree, try to find the Rat-Man.

videos.title: Cuda I Have This Dance?
videos.overview: Booker, Neil and Ivy go to prom, while Alice hosts her first middle school sleepover.

videos.title: You've Got Sale
videos.overview: The Baxters host a garage sale and try to one-up their neighbors. Alice sells her Tasha doll only to regret the decision, and Booker stresses over his college choice.

videos.title: Gown to the Wire
videos.overview: Raven gets the opportunity to take her fashion designs global, Booker may not be able to walk at graduation, Victor has big news, and Alice gets a surprise call from an old friend.

videos.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
videos.overview: Raven recruits Victor to help her impress a very important investor, Booker and Neil try out being college roommates, and Alice struggles to enjoy her summer plans.
